subject: Lakeview Health - Marketplace PO alignment & milestone plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Clark <susan.clark@lakeviewhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft + SOW (Lakeview Health)

Hi Susan —

Great to speak earlier. As promised, attaching a first-pass mutual action plan and the SOW to align procurement, legal, and billing so we can close via AWS Private Offer. High-level asks below and then a compact MAP with target dates.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the primary procurement contact and the PO cadence (single PO vs quarterly PO)?
- Will Lakeview accept marketplace invoicing (AWS Marketplace) or do you need a third-party invoice from Redwood?
- Legal: any non-standard contract terms we should surface now?

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) 10/12: Send SOW + MAP (this email) — action: Lakeview review
2) 10/16: Procurement confirmation (contact + PO format) — action: Lakeview procurement
3) 10/20: AWS private offer issued by Redwood/AWS — action: Redwood / AWS marketplace rep
4) 10/23: Legal redline complete or exception list agreed — action: Lakeview legal / Redwood legal
5) 10/26: PO acceptance and marketplace offer acceptance — action: Lakeview procurement
6) 10/27: Billing kickoff / invoice schedule confirmed — action: Redwood finance / Lakeview AP

Attachment: Lakeview_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

If those dates work I’ll loop in Marcus from finance to confirm invoice samples and Laura for onboarding milestones.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.

— Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Susan Clark <susan.clark@lakeviewhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Peter Choi <peter.choi@lakeviewhealth.com>
Date: 2028-10-13T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + SOW (Lakeview Health)

Aditya —

Thanks for the MAP and SOW. A few quick answers and open items from our side:
- Procurement contact: Peter Choi (cc’d) is our CFO and will own PO issuance.
- PO cadence: We prefer a single quarterly PO if possible; for initial purchase we can issue a one-time PO.
- Billing: Preference is marketplace invoicing if there is no added tax complexity. If Redwood needs to invoice directly we will need vendor onboarding information.
- Legal: We have a standard BA/processing addendum to attach; our counsel will review the SOW for data residency clauses — the work is HIPAA-adjacent and we need clarity on logging and retention.

Could you confirm whether accepting the AWS Private Offer will allow us to get a single consolidated invoice monthly? Also please share a sample invoice so our AP team can pre-validate.

I’ll review the SOW with legal and aim to come back with redlines by 10/19.

Best,
Susan
Director, IT Procurement
Lakeview Health

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Clark <susan.clark@lakeviewhealth.com>, Peter Choi <peter.choi@lakeviewhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-15T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + SOW (Lakeview Health)

Thanks Susan / Peter — looping Marcus Lin (finance) for the invoice sample and to confirm billing paths. Quick answers:
- AWS Private Offer with marketplace invoicing generally supports consolidated monthly invoicing to the customer (Lakeview will receive an invoice from AWS or AWS Marketplace Partner Billing depending on the setup). We’ve done this for several hospital systems — it maps to a single monthly invoice if you accept the private offer.
- Alternative direct invoicing from Redwood is possible but requires standard vendor onboarding (W9, bank details).

I’m dropping the AWS Private Offer link below — once you confirm procurement cadence we’ll trigger the offer.

Attachment: AWS_Private_Offer_Link.url (link)
Related HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/LK-98765/deal/DL-2028-0457

Onboarding note: Laura will follow up with a minimal onboarding checklist (network allowlist, service account, contact list).

Aditya

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Peter Choi <peter.choi@lakeviewhealth.com>, Susan Clark <susan.clark@lakeviewhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-18T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood invoice sample & payment terms

Hi Peter / Susan —

Appended a short invoice example and a few payment-term options so your AP team can validate. If you accept marketplace invoices via AWS the final invoice will come through AWS systems; we’ve aligned the line-item names below to match AWS Marketplace descriptions to make reconciliation easier.

Sample options (summary):
- Marketplace monthly consolidated invoice (preferred): single line per subscription, net 30 by default; Redwood can accommodate net 45 upon request for enterprise agreements.
- Direct invoice from Redwood: net 30; requires vendor onboarding and a PO that references our Redwood vendor ID (will provide upon request).

Attachment: Redwood_invoice_sample.xlsx (xlsx, 8KB)

Please let me know if net 45 is required for the initial quarter and we’ll note that in the offer.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Finance Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Subject: MAP updated — target acceptance week & next steps

All —

Thanks for the quick turn. I updated the MAP and SOW per our thread (attached DocuSign link for the SOW so legal can sign once redlines are resolved). New target timeline below based on Lakeview feedback:

Updated milestones:
- 10/19: Lakeview legal redlines due (per Susan) — action: Lakeview legal
- 10/21: Redwood issues AWS Private Offer (we’ve queued the offer with AWS) — action: Redwood / AWS Marketplace
- 10/25: Lakeview accepts offer and issues PO (target: single one-time PO for initial quarter) — action: Lakeview procurement
- 10/27: Billing cadence confirmed and first invoice scheduled (monthly consolidated invoice via AWS) — action: Redwood finance / Lakeview AP
- 11/01: Onboarding kickoff call (network allowlist, service accounts) — action: Laura / Lakeview IT

Attachments: DocuSign_Lakeview_SOW.link (signature request)

Next steps for Peter / Susan: confirm PO cadence (single PO is fine per your note), and once legal confirms redlines accept the DocuSign so we can finalize the private offer. Marcus, please proceed with net 30 by default unless Lakeview explicitly requests net 45 and we’ve confirmed that in writing.

If helpful I can generate a condensed timeline slide for your procurement committee — I’ll drop that into the HubSpot deal record.

Best,
Aditya Rao
